comments.author: huhtenberg
comments.story: A daredevil climber risking his life for breathtaking views
comments.why: The video that put these climbers on the map, with a great soundtrack
comments.text: For those who managed to miss the "Shanghai Tower" video from 2014 - this is what basically put this guy and his friend on the radar. An absolutely fantastic watch. Incidentally, it also helped putting some much deserved light on N'to and Worakls, whose Trauma track was used for the soundtrack. [VIDEO]

comments.story: GoPro cuts workforce, changes sales strategy

comments.text: I think it depends on what you are doing. If you are doing something intense enough, it works. Check out on the roofs, the guys who break into sky scraper construction sites and scale the buildings. Go Pros work perfectly for their use case: [VIDEO]
